title: Fill in the Blank: Binary Logic
prompt: Fill in the missing mnemonics or values to construct accurate binary logic operations.

blanks.prompt: Perform a Logical Shift Left to effectively multiply x20 by 8 (2^3).
blanks.explanation: LSL is a quick way to do multiplication by a power of two.

blanks.prompt: Perform a Bit Clear (AND NOT) operation on x20 using the mask in x21.
blanks.explanation: Bit Clear (bic) is actually AND NOT.

blanks.prompt: Use the standard alias for an Inclusive OR (orr) instruction with the zero register.
blanks.explanation: mov Xd, Xm is an alias for: orr Xd, xzr, Xm.

blanks.prompt: Sign-extend bit 7 of a byte in w20 to fill the rest of the 32-bit word in w19.
blanks.explanation: sxtb (Signed Extend Byte) sign-extends bit 7 in Wn to bits 8-31.

blanks.prompt: Perform an Arithmetic Shift Right by 1 to divide x20 by 2 while preserving the sign bit.
blanks.explanation: ASR preserves the sign when dividing by a power of two (Sign bit is duplicated when shifting).
